statement: A preserved in-process retry that resumes a join session after a readiness-phase failure reconstructs the local lifecycle through CONNECTING, DISCOVERING, and JOINING before readiness publication, reaches READY before FINALIZED or steady-state background-writer activation, retains the same durable join session without replaying completed membership side effects, and the unchanged movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live scenario reports priority metric 0 on three consecutive fresh runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Reuse the existing lifecycle state machine and resumed-infrastructure catch-up owner; do not mutate lifecycle state directly, add a parallel state path, replay completed infrastructure or membership side effects, or synthesize READY.

FINALIZED and steady-state background-writer activation must not succeed unless the canonical lifecycle owner confirms READY; an invalid transition must surface as a failure instead of logging completion or starting heartbeats.

Deterministic evidence must use the real join coordinator and durable session store: attempt one completes membership and fails retryably in readiness, cleanup leaves STOPPED, attempt two resets to STARTING, skips completed infrastructure and membership checkpoints, reruns readiness, and reaches READY with one session identity and no duplicated membership side effects.
The regression must prove steady-state writer activation observes local READY and cannot reassert a JOINING node row after the retry publishes the ready lease.
Fresh joins, same-state READY idempotence, and terminal non-retryable cleanup must retain their existing behavior.
Do not alter MovieLens formation or schema timeouts, polling cadence, retry budgets, workload, data volume, join count, process supervision, readiness predicates, or live runner ordering.

After source verification and checkpoint, run five fresh formation probes followed by three fresh MovieLens demos with one unchanged source fingerprint; stop on the first red result and diagnose the newly reached boundary before any rerun.
